==Description==
This template is used to link articles from [https://simpsonswiki.com/wiki/Main_Page Wikisimpsons] under "'''External links'''."

==Syntax==
<code><nowiki>{{</nowiki>SimpsonsWiki|''title'' (optional)}}</code>

Replace "title" with the exact name of the article on Wikisimpsons, not the name here. If the name is the same on both wikis, it can be omitted. (Any "/Legends" in the Wookieepedia article name will be included on the Wikisimpsons link, so make sure to fill in the title parameter manually.) Do not use <nowiki>{{PAGENAME}}</nowiki> for the title, as this will cause the Wikisimpsons link to change if our article is moved even if Wikisimpsons' article remains at the same name.

==Samples==
<code><nowiki>{{SimpsonsWiki|The Mandalorian}}</nowiki></code> 

results in...

{{SimpsonsWiki|The Mandalorian}}

<includeonly>[[Category:Interwiki link templates|{{PAGENAME}}]]</includeonly><noinclude>[[Category:Template documentation|{{PAGENAME}}]]</noinclude>
